Zero-Cost Lifetime Hosting

Deploy to GitHub Pages in 2 Minutes

Step 1: Save this File as index.html

This portal is engineered as a 100% self-contained single-file application with embedded graphics, Web Crypto passcode security, and direct Google Drive integration. Simply download this file and rename it to index.html.

Step 2: Push to a GitHub Repository

Create a new repository on GitHub (e.g., sebi-batch-2025-26), upload index.html, and go to Settings → Pages → Branch: main → Save. Your live site will be ready at https://<your-username>.github.io/sebi-batch-2025-26/!

Step 3: Chairman Inauguration Ceremony Ready

When projecting on the big screen at NISM or SEBI Bhavan, click the "✨ Inaugurate" button in the top header to launch the velvet-curtain ceremony for the Chairman!
